Get ready to flow and vibe as you unleash your inner alter ego with some trap beats and chill yoga moves.

About this Event

👑 TRAP YOGA: ALTER EGO EDITION 👑
Brown Suga Yogi Presents an experience where yoga meets music, cocktails, costumes, and unapologetic YOU!
It's time to step outside your comfort zone and into your ALTER EGO. 🔥
Who do you become when you stop playing small?
Your alter ego could be:
✨ The CEO
💃🏾 The Diva
👑 The Superstar
😈 The Villain
🔥 The Bad B*tch
🌟 Your Dream Self
🦄 Or literally whoever YOU want to be!
Come dressed as your alter ego and get ready for an energetic, fun-filled evening of Trap Yoga, cocktails/mocktails, games, music, small bites, and good vibes!

🧘🏾‍♀️ WHAT TO EXPECT🔥 Energetic Trap Yoga Session
🍹 Cocktails & Mocktails
🍴 Small Bites
🎶 Music & Good Vibes
🎲 Fun Games
🏆 Best Alter Ego/Costume Contest
👑 A night of self-expression, movement & community

📅 EVENT DETAILSFriday, October 23, 2026
7:00 PM – 8:30 PM
C. Rose Event Center
🎟️ Admission: $20
Your $20 admission includes:
• Cocktails/Mocktails
• Small Bites
• Energetic Yoga Session
• Games
• Entry into the Best Alter Ego Best Costume Contest
Must be 21 to drink.
Yoga mats are NOT provided. Please bring your own yoga mat.
(Limited amount availalbe upon request)

💜 ALL LEVELS WELCOMEWhether you're brand new to yoga or you've been practicing for years, you're welcome here!
This class is beginner-friendly and designed to be fun, energetic, and accessible for all yoga levels.
Come ready to move, laugh, sweat, celebrate yourself, and step into your alter ego!

👑 COME AS YOUR ALTER EGOThis is your permission to be whoever you want to be for the night.
Go all out. Keep it simple. Get creative.
Just come ready to have FUN!
YOGA. COCKTAILS. COSTUMES. GOOD VIBES.

🎟️ LIMITED SPACES AVAILABLEGrab your ticket and secure your spot for Trap Yoga: Alter Ego Edition!
